children: Principal Financial Group entered into an amended and restated unsecured five-year revolving credit facility to support liquidity and general corporate purposes. The $900 million facility, led by Wells Fargo Bank as administrative agent, can be increased to $1.3 billion subject to conditions. It matures on Sep 9, 2031, with up to two optional one-year extensions, and includes revised pricing and expanded operational flexibility. There were no borrowings outstanding at closing.
: Amended and restated unsecured five-year revolving credit facility
: Wells Fargo Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: 5 years to Sep 09 2031; up to two 1-year extensions
: Refinance revolver and enhance liquidity flexibility
